title: Hermes Rich UI catalog
description: Read-only A2UI v1.0 catalog for hermes-rich-ui cards: 18 presentation components, zero functions. Single source of truth for admission (engine/admission.py) and the desktop renderer.
instructions: hermes-rich-ui/1 is a READ-ONLY presentation catalog: 18 component types, no functions, no actions, no inputs. Compose ONE tree: exactly one component has id "root" (normally a Card). Containers (Card/Stack/Grid) reference children by id; Tabs/Accordion reference one child per tab/item; every other type is a leaf. Each id is used by exactly one parent; no cycles, no unreachable components. Bind values with {"path": "/data/..."} or {"path": "/meta/..."} (RFC 6901); every path must resolve. null means UNKNOWN and renders as unavailable — never write 0 for a missing number. Never invent series, rows, bins or history: chart/table data must come from the supplied data or a declared derivation. Cite: put sourceIds on claims and rows, end with a SourceList; state method and caveat in derivations. Budgets: <=64 components, depth <=8, series <=4x512 points, tables <=100x12, timeline <=30, key/value <=32, strings <=4 KiB. Admission rejects (never truncates) anything outside this catalog.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

children.description: Ordered child component ids (1..32). Each id may be used by exactly one parent.

footer.description: E1: caption line rendered under children (replaces the trailing Text variant=caption + its id ceremony).

Divider.description: Horizontal rule with an optional label.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

orientation.description: E4: vertical is a 1px-wide full-height rule for horizontal Stacks (not the floating 1px stub).

Tabs.description: Tabbed container; each tab shows exactly one child component.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

defaultTab.description: E5: seed tab index. Out-of-range values are clamped into range by the renderer (min/max here name the bound; tabs has maxItems 8).

Accordion.description: Collapsible sections; each item shows exactly one child component.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

Text.description: Plain text paragraph. Newlines are kept; no markdown, no HTML.

Metric.description: Single number with label. null renders as unavailable, never as 0.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

previous.description: E11: prior-period value. The RENDERER computes delta and percent-delta (L6): null previous or null value renders NO delta row; previous 0 renders percent as unavailable, never inf/100% (RATIFY S9).

invertTone.description: E11: lower-is-better metrics (costs): up renders red, down green. Default false = neutral direction tone mapping.

Progress.description: Progress bar; missing/null total or current renders indeterminate.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

target.description: E12: target tick + 'vs target' counter line. target greater than total names the relation instead of silently clamping the display.

unit.description: E12: unit suffix for the current/total counter (ends unitless '73 / 100').

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

items.description: Up to 32 label/value pairs (literal or bound).

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

format.description: E13: routed through formatMetric ONLY when value is a JSON number; any string value + format renders the raw string verbatim (never coerced, L1).

Image.description: Static image from an https URL; alt text is required.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

src.description: https:// only; no credentials, no control characters.

DataTable.description: Sortable/filterable/paged table (local interaction only). Null never sorts as 0.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

key.description: Row key this column reads. A `sources` column reads a string[] of source ids under THIS key (REVIEW-C0 E11).

label.description: Authored label renders byte-identical; omitted label is humanized from the key (#34).

columns.description: Optional (#34): omit for rows-only inference — one column per row key, types inferred from cell JSON types (bar/sources are never inferred), humanized labels.

rows.description: Up to 100 row objects whose keys are declared column keys; cells are finite scalars. For a column of type `sources` the cell under that column's key is a string[] of source ids, each resolving in /meta/sources (dangling ids reject).

defaultSort.description: E15: seed sort (deletes agent pre-sorting). Unknown key falls back to unsorted. Nulls sort last in both directions; nonnumeric cells never Number()-coerced. dir optional: type-aware default (desc for numeric/date, asc for text) (#34).

Chart.description: uPlot chart. bar: zero baseline; line: null splits the line; scatter: no fitted line; histogram: bins supplied, never computed.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

data.description: Up to 512 points shaped per kind: see $defs/ChartPoint_<kind>.

sortDesc.description: Sort bar/histogram categories descending in the renderer (L6 — never hand-sort series). Only valid on kind bar/histogram; other kinds rejected at admission naming the valid kinds.

stack.description: Stack bar/area series (renderer-computed cumulative baselines; never hand-precompute them). Only valid on kind bar/area; other kinds rejected at admission naming the valid kinds.

stepped.description: Step the line (value holds until the next observation; no interpolation after the last point). Only valid on kind line; other kinds rejected at admission naming the valid kinds.

height.description: F1: chart plot height in px. Absent uses the renderer default (240); out-of-range values are clamped into 120..480 by the renderer (min/max here name the bound).

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.
Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

SourceList.description: Renders the referenced sources (sourceIds; default: all of /meta/sources) with labels, links and notes.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

Checklist.description: Undated checklist of booleans (Checklist = undated booleans; Timeline = dated). The renderer computes the done tally; null/absent done renders UNKNOWN, never guessed.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

items.description: Up to 32 check items (literal or bound): {label, done? true|false|null, sourceIds?}.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

ChipSet.description: One flex-wrap row of chip labels rendered as badges (replaces N separate Badge components). Labels are data, not keys: duplicates allowed. tone is Badge's existing four exactly.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

labels.description: Up to 24 chip labels (literal or bound); duplicates allowed.

CodeBlock.description: Monospace code/config/shell block, literal text only. No markdown, no HTML, no syntax highlighting. 'language' is a LABEL ONLY, never parsed. 'code' is capped at 4 KiB (UTF-8); over-cap input is rejected at admission, never truncated. 'showLines' renders per-line numbers in the renderer; the agent never numbers lines itself.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

ImageGallery.description: Evidence strip of up to 8 tiles (one component replaces Image+alt+caption Text x N). Each src is https://-only; admission never fetched or verified any URL — tiles render exactly what fails to load.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

items.description: Up to 8 tiles; every src is https://-only (URL-key swept); alt is required.

src.description: https:// only; no credentials, no control characters. Admission never fetched or verified this URL.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

AsOf.description: Evidence-law caption line: Observed/Published timestamps (Accessed is source-scoped in SourceList, F8). Only publish timestamps you actually observed — date-only precision is honest when that is all you observed; leave absent if unknown.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

observedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp you ACTUALLY OBSERVED; leave absent if unknown — never publish a timestamp you did not observe.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the source ACTUALLY PUBLISHED; leave absent if unknown — never publish a timestamp you did not observe.

Sparkline.description: Tiny inline trend strip for KPI rows, rendered beside a Metric. min/max normalization and the up/down/flat trend chip are computed by the renderer (never hand-pick arrows); null values are gaps, never 0.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

values.description: Up to 512 number|null points; null renders a gap (never 0). Provide values or series, never both hand-duplicated.

series.description: Alias for values (at most one of values/series). Up to 512 number|null points; null renders a gap (never 0).

BarList.description: Ranked list with inline bars (typically 4..12 rows). Widths proportional to value/columnMax are computed by the renderer; null values sink last and render 'unavailable', never 0-width or 0-valued; negatives clip at 0 with a blank share. Values render via the Metric formatter (format/precision/unit). Anything already tabular belongs in DataTable.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

items.description: Up to 30 ranked rows {label, value(number|null), sourceIds?}.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

HeatMap.description: rows x cols matrix as a DOM grid (max 12 rows x 12 cols, max 144 cells — the single reachable cap; no separate engine constant). The color ramp across the OBSERVED min/max is computed by the renderer; the caption prints observed min/max with the unit. null/missing cells hatch as an em-dash, never a guessed color.

sourceIds.description: Evidence links; every id must resolve in /meta/sources.

cells.description: Up to 144 cells {row, col, value(number|null)}; every row/col must name a declared label and one cell per (row, col) pair (admission rejects duplicates and dangling refs).

ComponentId.description: Component id; unique within the surface. Never __proto__/constructor/prototype (REVIEW-C0 E3).

DataBinding.description: JSON Pointer into the surface dataModel; must start with /data/ or /meta/ and resolve.

ChartPoint_line.description: line point: x is a finite number or an ISO-8601 string (datetime.fromisoformat, trailing Z allowed); one series never mixes the two.

ChartPoint_histogram.description: histogram bin: low < high; bins sorted ascending and non-overlapping.

ChartPoint_area.description: area point: same shape as line ({x: ISO|string|number, y:number|null}) — $ref alias to ChartPoint_line; the fill toward zero is a renderer concern.

ChartPoint_range.description: range point: {label, low: number|null, high: number|null}; low <= high (equality allowed, RATIFY S3); both null renders 'unavailable' — exactly-one-null is rejected.

ChartPoint_waterfall.description: waterfall point: {label, value: number|null, total?: bool}; signed steps (e.g. +100 revenue, -40 cost) and the running baseline are computed by the renderer; a FIRST point with total:true and a numeric value is the opening anchor (pins 0->value and starts the running balance); later total:true rows pin the base to zero and show the renderer-computed running total (their value is ignored). Never hand-compute cumulative columns.
